prediction.model: LightGBM on physics features + Sightglass rationale engine
prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.4 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS2 mean temperature 41.9 °C (within 1% of healthy). Operating temperatures and thermal gradient remain within optimal baseline specifications.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.93 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.56 s (3% above healthy). Prolonged pressure rise time and marked switching lag between pressure lines point to severe directional valve response lag.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.41 l/min (3% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 399 W·min/l (4% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 55.6 % (5% below healthy). High power-to-flow ratio demonstrates extensive internal leakage across the pump chambers.
Accumulator: slightly reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.2 bar (within 1% of healthy). Slight increase in pressure oscillations indicates reduced surge dampening capacity.

tslm_prediction.rationale:
Cooler: full efficiency. Evidence: TS1 temperature slope 0.393 °C/min (within 1% of healthy); TS4 mean temperature 31.2 °C (within 1% of healthy). Heat exchanger maintains expected fluid cooling delta without thermal drift.
Valve: severe lag. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 9.91 s (within 1% of healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.56 s (3% above healthy). Transient response is severely sluggish, preventing timely transition of working pressure.
Pump leakage: weak leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.49 l/min (within 1% of healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 392 W·min/l (2% above healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.8 % (3% below healthy). Volumetric delivery is slightly compromised due to minor internal bypass flow.
Accumulator: severely reduced. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 47.5 bar (within 2% of healthy). Pressure buffering is largely ineffective due to compromised pre-charge pressure in the accumulator.
